# Cleaning
```{r}
demfalse <- demfalse %>% rename(DemFalseCoef=DemCoeffs, DemFalseSE=DemSEs) %>% dplyr::select(DemFalseCoef, DemFalseSE)

demtrue <- demtrue %>% rename(DemTrueCoef=Coeffs, DemTrueSE=SEs) %>% dplyr::select(DemTrueCoef, DemTrueSE)

repfalse <- repfalse %>% rename(RepFalseCoef=estimate, RepFalseSE=std.error) %>% dplyr::select(RepFalseCoef, RepFalseSE)

reptrue <- reptrue %>% rename(RepTrueCoef=Coeffs, RepTrueSE=SEs) %>% dplyr::select(RepTrueCoef, RepTrueSE)

x <- simple %>% dplyr::select(Exclude_NonPoliticalNewsSharers:Partisanship)

x <- cbind(x, repfalse, demfalse, reptrue, demtrue)
```

```{r}
x$Treatment[x$Treatment=="Evaluation + Importance"] <- "Evaluation or Importance"

x$Treatment <- factor(x$Treatment, levels=c("Multiple Interventions", "Evaluation or Importance", "Evaluation", "No Norms or Tips", "No Tips", "No Norms", "All"))

x$RepFalseCI <- x$RepFalseSE*qnorm(0.975)
x$DemFalseCI <- x$DemFalseSE*qnorm(0.975)
x$RepTrueCI <- x$RepTrueSE*qnorm(0.975)
x$DemTrueCI <- x$DemTrueSE*qnorm(0.975)
```

Plots.
```{r}
RepFalse <- ggplot(x, aes(x=RepFalseCoef, y=Treatment, color=Partisanship, group=Partisanship, shape=Exclude_NonPoliticalNewsSharers))+
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin=RepFalseCoef-RepFalseCI, xmax=RepFalseCoef+RepFalseCI), position=position_dodge2(width = 0.5, padding=0.5))+scale_color_manual(values=c("red", "orange", "green", "blue", "purple"))+xlim(-0.1, 0.1)+geom_vline(aes(xintercept=0), color="black", linetype="dashed", size=1)+theme_classic()+xlab("Acc Prompt on Republican False News Sharing")
```

```{r}
DemFalse <- ggplot(x, aes(x=DemFalseCoef, y=Treatment, color=Partisanship, group=Partisanship, shape=Exclude_NonPoliticalNewsSharers))+
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin=DemFalseCoef-DemFalseCI, xmax=DemFalseCoef+DemFalseCI), position=position_dodge2(width = 0.5, padding=0.5))+scale_color_manual(values=c("red", "orange", "green", "blue", "purple"))+xlim(-0.1, 0.1)+geom_vline(aes(xintercept=0), color="black", linetype="dashed", size=1)+theme_classic()+xlab("Acc Prompt on Democrat False News Sharing")
```
